win_system.notes: Ways with xNudge and xSplit Wilds; exact count not printed.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Knock Knock and wins trigger collapses; every 3rd avalanche unlocks a Death Meter level.

other.name: Death Meter
other.how_it_works: 5 levels; every 3rd avalanche unlocks a level converting a character type to Wilds for the round. L5 first unlock sets global mult ×2 then +1 per later L5; may fire Mental Patient / xSplit Wild / xNudge Wild then re-locks L5.

other.name: Knock Knock
other.how_it_works: 3+ same aligned horizontally with no win → remove, place Mental Patients in middle (keep mult), explode others except Scatter/Wild/Mental Patient → collapse.

other.name: xNudge Wild
other.how_it_works: Drops to bottom (+1 mult per pass), expands full reel; only split symbols raise mult while expanding; consecutive nudge mults add; applies to wins involving the Wild.

wilds.name: Wild / Character Wild
wilds.behavior: From Death Meter conversions; can become xSplit or xNudge Wild at L5.

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: Drop+expand mult rules; can boost global mult in Ding Dong Death Spins when in a win.

wilds.name: xSplit Wild
wilds.behavior: Splits/doubles row except Scatter; doubles xNudge mult if split.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3/4/5 → 7/9/11 Ding Dong Spins; 6 → 13 Ding Dong Death Spins. Scatter in FS → +1 spin.

multipliers.name: Global / xNudge
multipliers.behavior: Death Meter L5 sets/raises global mult; nudge mults add.

specials.name: Mental Patient
specials.behavior: From Knock Knock or L5 feature; wild-like special in collapses.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways cascades on 3×6 with Death Meter (every 3rd avalanche), Knock Knock, xNudge/xSplit. 3–5 Scatter → Ding Dong 7/9/11; 6 → Ding Dong Death 13. Boosters 2×/50×/100×/200×/300×. xTra keeps meter+mult. Cap 14,280×.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional Bonus Booster 2×, Death Meter 3/4/5, xNudge Booster 300×.

phases.name: Cascade + meter
phases.what_happens: Evaluate; Knock Knock; avalanches unlock Death Meter levels/features.

phases.name: Bonus / xTra
phases.what_happens: 3–6 Scatter → FS; else Extra Spin if cost ≤ win.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after nudge/split/Knock Knock; global mult from Death Meter.

modes.name: Ding Dong Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Death Meter and global win mult do not reset.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or Knock Knock Who's There? 14,280×.

modes.name: Ding Dong Death Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All Ding Dong features; each unlocked meter level +1 global mult; L5 only +1 (no special feature); xNudge win adds to global mult.

features.name: Bonus Booster
features.effects: 3× more likely Ding Dong / Death Spins.

options.name: xTra Spin
options.effects: Keep meter/mult if cost ≤ total win.

ante_bet.notes: Bonus Booster 2× is the light per-spin FS boost.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Ding Dong 7/9/11; Death 13; Death Meter; boosters; max 14280×.
